entry.title: New: Resolution 376 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE, NATIONAL OCEANIC AND ATMOSPHERIC ADMINISTRATION, TO RECEIVE A GRANT FOR THE PUAPUAʻA IKI HABITAT RESTORATION PROJECT FOR INVASIVE SPECIES MANAGEMENT AND SHORELINE STABILIZATION

Allows for the receipt of $1,901,521 of federally-derived funds to restore eleven and a half acres of deforested land in Puapuaʻa Iki in North Kona.
